name: EU Quantum Flagship
description: The Quantum Flagship is a large-scale research initiative by the European Commission with a budget of €1 billion over 10 years. It supports cutting-edge quantum technology research and development across Europe, including quantum computing, communication, sensing, and simulation. The flagship aims to consolidate and expand European scientific leadership in quantum technologies.
